ideas.pitch: A transparent agricultural supply chain and quality tracking system leveraging immutable local ledgers to prevent spoilage disputes between farmers and cold-chain distributors.
ideas.title: VeriFarm Supply Chain Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Agriculture is a major stated domain track, and implementing a real cryptographic or structured ledger solves a genuine verification pain point that judges in rural-tech tracks love to see.

ideas.pitch: An automated medical insurance claim auditor that cross-references hospital bills with internal policy guidelines to catch wrongful rejections before submission.
ideas.title: MediClaim Audit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner pattern from the RAISE Summit by tackling insurance friction with precise document parsing and policy grounding, which appeals heavily to FinTech and Healthcare judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated graph-based risk scoring dashboard for detecting suspicious fintech transaction rings using lightweight graph intelligence and explainable machine learning rules.
ideas.title: AuraGraph AML Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the FinTech domain by implementing complex graph-based intelligence similar to a 1st place DIGITIMES AI winner, demonstrating serious technical depth over simple UI wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise carbon footprint tracker and micro-incentive marketplace tailored for campus and urban environments to quantify sustainability metrics.
ideas.title: CampusCarb Track
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Environment & Sustainable Development track by providing clear, measurable impact metrics which judges prioritize over qualitative sustainability pitches.

ideas.pitch: An adaptive curriculum generation tool for technical bootcamps that dynamically updates learning paths based on real-time code execution failures.
ideas.title: SkillPath AI Mentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: EduTech judges look for practical classroom tools that solve student drop-off, offering immediate utility and clear pedagogical value.
